text: Residents have expressed concerns that there no locations for pedestrians to cross Moore Avenue/Southvale Drive, between the traffic signals at Bayview Avenue and the all-way stop at Rolph Road, 550 metres to the east. Midway on this section of Moore Avenue/Southvale Drive there is an eastbound stop sign at the east intersection with Mallory Crescent but there are no north-south crosswalk lines. Transportation Services staff have advised this is due to the corresponding westbound stop sign is posted 60 metres further east at Astor Avenue. This long spacing between the east-west stop signs, as well as a curve in the road, results in inadequate visibility of pedestrians crossing north-south at this offset intersection. Transportation Services staff have advised that relocating the westbound stop sign at Astor Avenue to Mallory Crescent (east leg) would address the visibility concern and…

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the compulsory stop control on Southvale Drive (westbound) at the intersection of Southvale Drive and Astor Avenue. 2. Rescinded the compulsory stop control on Moore Avenue (eastbound) at the intersection of Moore Avenue and Mallory Crescent. 3. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Moore Avenue/Southvale Drive and Mallory Crescent (east intersection).
